comment: Deterministic tagging rules. Mechanic tags mirror the dataset's parsed keyword abilities. Gameplay tags match fullText case-insensitively; a card is tagged when any include pattern matches and no exclude pattern matches. Payoff rules extract typed payoffs (src/text/refs.ts interprets the named groups); order matters — shift-family rules consume their spans before effect-text rules run on the remainder.

payoffRules.pattern: Duo Shift (?<cost>\d+)(?: ?⬡)?(?: \(You may pay \d+(?: ?⬡)? to play this on top of two of your characters, one named (?<name1>[A-Z][A-Za-z'&.,-]*?(?: [A-Za-z'&.,-]+)*?) and one named (?<name2>[A-Z][A-Za-z'&.,-]*?(?: [A-Za-z'&.,-]+)*?)\))?

Combo Shift (?<cost>\d+)(?: ?⬡)?(?: \(You may pay \d+(?: ?⬡)? to play this on top of one of your characters named (?<name1>[A-Z][A-Za-z'&.,-]*?(?: [A-Za-z'&.,-]+)*?), one named (?<name2>[A-Z][A-Za-z'&.,-]*?(?: [A-Za-z'&.,-]+)*?), or one of each\.?\))?
Universal Shift (?<cost>\d+)(?: ?⬡)?(?: \(You may pay \d+(?: ?⬡)? to play this on top of any one of your characters[^)]*\))?
Potato Shift (?<cost>\d+)(?: ?⬡)?(?: \(You may pay \d+(?: ?⬡)? to play this on top of one of your items named (?<name>[A-Z][A-Za-z'&.,-]*?(?: [A-Za-z'&.,-]+)*?)\))?
